run_generate_creative_birds: run the script to generate creative bird images from initial stroke sketches using pretrained DoodlerGAN models
run_generate_all_birds: run the script with --generate_all to generate complete colored bird images from all initial strokes in the dataset
generate_part: generate a specific bird part like eye, head, or wings using the conditional UNet model and initial strokes
generate_truncated: generate bird images with truncated noise for improved sample quality using the style mapping and generator networks
gs_to_rgb: convert a grayscale bird sketch tensor to RGB by applying a specified color from the COLORS dictionary
